verdict.rationale: Isaac ecosystem provides reusable ready-to-use packages (Isaac ROS navigation/perception packages, Isaac Sim Python namespace packages installable via pip, GR00T pretrained models, Isaac Lab task/environment libraries) that developers can pull for common hardware and behaviors, and supports importing hardware descriptions (URDF/MJCF/CAD) as reusable assets. Missing for 10: no explicit centralized 'registry' UI/marketplace evidence, no independent hands-on confirmation of package discovery/versioning workflow.
